primitives.name: Etienne Usage Risk Assessment
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Adversarial verdict:** The 8.4-target projection and 20.7-touch workload projection were made BEFORE Kamara was confirmed active (dknetwork 9/17 table; projections dated pre-Friday).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes Kamara's return disrupts Etienne's established target and touch distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Kamara returns healthy, the model breaks because it doesn't account for the new player entering the backfield competition.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's Bayesian hierarchical shrinkage model where new evidence (Kamara active) updates prior distributions, causing posterior revision of Etienne's usage metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Drop in Etienne's actual targets or touches below the projected 8.4 threshold in Week 2.

primitives.name: Kamara Debut Speculation
primitives.verbatim_quote: But first-game-back usage after a month out with an MCL sprain is genuinely unknown — Saints Wire literally wrote "we'll see." Treat as tournament-only speculation, not a cash value.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes Kamara's immediate reclamation of his historical receiving role upon return.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The model fails if Kamara's first-game-back usage is conservative due to injury concerns, limiting his impact.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's Markov decision process where the initial state (Kamara's health status) influences the transition probabilities to high-receiving scenarios versus cautious usage.
layer2.telemetry: Kamara's receiving volume (targets or receptions) in Week 2 compared to his projected 8.3 targets.

primitives.name: Harvey Injury Fade
primitives.verbatim_quote: He stays playable in GPPs (Saints run-heavy identity, BAL allows work) but is no longer a "clean" anything.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes Harvey's injury history and limited Week 1 performance create volatility that makes him unsuitable for core lineup construction.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The primitive collapses when Harvey proves durable and effective, becoming a legitimate flex option.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's conformal prediction framework where Harvey's uncertain health state creates a wide prediction interval, making him a high-variance, low-confidence pick.
layer2.telemetry: Actual touches and yards for Harvey in Week 2 relative to his salary-based expectations.

primitives.name: Henry Blowout Risk
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Second source:** Heavy.com (9/18) confirms full participation + expected debut; SI (9/17) confirms activation.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a significant point spread will trigger conservative coaching decisions that bench Henry in the fourth quarter.
primitives.breakdown_regime: The model holds only if the game remains competitive; if Baltimore wins by more than 18 points, Henry's workload drops sharply.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's state-transition model where the score differential (state variable) triggers a policy switch from maximizing Henry's reps to preserving his health, altering his expected contribution.
layer2.telemetry: Final point differential between Baltimore and New Orleans at the end of the third quarter.
